understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by placing each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +; when multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action using pixel coordinates spaced 3 pixels apart. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed while moving, walls and boundaries could block movement in ways that required experimentation, and CLICK switched control between selectable pieces using their displayed pixel positions. Movement hints were only heuristic, so blocked directions sometimes still needed to be tried.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by placing each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +; when multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action using pixel coordinates spaced 3 pixels apart. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed while moving, walls and boundaries could block movement in ways that required experimentation, and CLICK switched control between selectable pieces using their displayed pixel positions. Movement hints were only heuristic, so blocked directions sometimes still needed to be tried.
